bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: I would never see it; at most the proof request I get mentions a reason that came from the job description.
bundles.why: It is the recruiter's setup screen, so it only matters to me if it makes the requests for proof sensible.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: The night I upload my CV and hope nobody reads the wrong dates or my name wrongly.
bundles.why: I care that my CV is read correctly and personal details are protected, but I do not see this part.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: Waiting a few days after applying to hear if I got shortlisted or not.
bundles.why: A person confirming and giving reasons feels fairer to me than a machine rejecting me quietly.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: On the bus after a night shift, opening the email on my phone to upload my degree and GitHub link.
bundles.why: I need a clear, safe-looking page that says who sees my documents and why, and confirms the file was sent, or I will think it is a scam.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: Getting a reply about another job I applied for and was not chosen for.
bundles.why: Specific feedback tells me what to improve, but I would still apply if it were missing.

bundles.when_i_would_meet_it: I would not meet it at all.
bundles.why: It is only for the HR lead and does not touch my application, though I like that it does not name people.

proof_timing.why: Sending degree papers to a company I know nothing about before they even want me feels risky and like a scam, but after being shortlisted with a stated reason I would go ahead.
